instructions: Start with the dipping sauce. In a medium bowl, stir 6 tbsp of the sugar into 2/3 cup warm water until it dissolves. Stir in 6 tbsp of the fish sauce and the 1/4 cup rice vinegar.
Juice 2 of the limes. You want about 1/4 cup. Stir it into the sauce, and cut the last lime into wedges for the table.
Mince 4 of the garlic cloves and stir them into the sauce.
Peel the carrot and slice it into thin coins. Drop them into the sauce and leave it to sit while you do the rest.
Slice the 2 chilies and put them in a small bowl for the table.
Fill a large pot with water and bring it to a boil for the noodles.
Meanwhile, finely chop the green onions until you have about 2/3 cup. Mince the last 2 garlic cloves.

Put the 1.25 lb pork in a large bowl with the green onions, the garlic, the last 2 tbsp fish sauce, the last 4 tsp sugar, the 1/4 tsp white pepper and the 1/4 tsp salt. Mix it with your hands for about 1 minute, until it's sticky and holds together.
Wet your hands and shape the pork into 12 small patties, each about 1/2 inch thick. Set them on a plate.
Add the 8 oz vermicelli to the boiling water and cook it the way the packet says, usually 3 to 5 minutes, until soft. Drain it, rinse it under cold water and leave it in the colander to drain well.
Rinse the 8 oz bean sprouts. Wash and dry the lettuce, the cilantro and the mint. Tear the lettuce into pieces and pile it on a platter with the herb sprigs and the bean sprouts.

Heat 1 1/2 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet over medium high. Add half the patties with space between them. Leave them alone for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes, until the underside is deep golden and they let go of the pan.

Flip them and cook the other side for 2 to 3 minutes. You're cooking them to 160°F in the middle, so if you have a thermometer, check one there. No thermometer? Cut one open: it's done when there's no pink left. Move them to a plate.
Add the last 1 1/2 tbsp oil to the pan and cook the rest of the patties the same way.
Taste the dipping sauce. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt or a squeeze of the lime.
Pour the dipping sauce and the carrot slices into 4 small bowls and put 3 patties in each. Serve with the noodles, the lettuce and herb platter, the lime wedges and the sliced chilies on the side.
method_notes: All three read versions season ground pork with fish sauce, sugar, garlic and shallot or green onion, shape it into small patties and serve them with a sweet, sour and salty fish sauce dipping broth, cold rice vermicelli, lettuce and herbs. RecipeTin Eats (the lead) pan-fries the patties in a skillet with no marinating time and makes a lime and rice vinegar dipping sauce with garlic and chilli. Grantourismo and SBS also grill marinated slices of pork belly over charcoal, marinate the meat for 2 hours or overnight, and add pickled carrot, radish or green papaya. This one follows the lead's skillet patties and sauce, soaks thin carrot slices in the sauce and puts the chilies on the side.
